items.title_en: US family's bizarre blue skin condition explained after decades of inbreeding
items.title_zh: 经过数十年的近亲繁殖，美国家庭奇怪的蓝色皮肤状况得到了解释
items.summary_en: An incestuous family ended up turning blue after generations of members kept having children with one another. Now, this isn't talking about the 'most inbred family in America', which is the title of the Whittaker family in West Virginia . This is the family that has been well- documented online for inbreeding over a course of a century, with many family members having disabilities as a result. Instead, the blue skin Fugate family are those who lived in a rural community in Troublesome Creek, Kentucky, and…
items.summary_zh: 一个乱伦家庭在几代成员不断生孩子后最终变成了蓝色。现在，这不是在谈论“美国最近亲繁殖的家庭”，这是西弗吉尼亚州惠特克家族的称号。一个世纪以来，这个家庭的近亲繁殖在网上已有详细记录，许多家庭成员因此患有残疾。相反，蓝皮肤 Fugate 家族是那些住在 T 农村社区的人。

items.title_en: Top psychic who 'predicted 2026 war' reveals chilling 'nine disasters' the world is facing
items.title_zh: “预测2026年战争”的顶级通灵者揭示了世界面临的令人毛骨悚然的“九大灾难”
items.summary_en: A psychic with a track record of getting things right has revealed her next major prediction which could see it impact nations all over the world. Angela Kuschel is a self-reported 'natural born' psychic and paranormal investigator from Florida and has previously predicted the likes of war and destruction. However, she's since turned her eye to a number of terrifying things we could see shortly before the end of the year. This news comes as she delivered a whopping nine predictions to the Express , which includes…
items.summary_zh: 一位有着把事情做对的记录的通灵者透露了她的下一个重大预测，这可能会影响世界各地的国家。安吉拉·库舍尔 (Angela Kuschel) 是一位来自佛罗里达州的“天生”通灵和超自然现象调查员，她此前曾预测过战争和破坏之类的事情。然而，从那以后，她把目光转向了我们在年底前不久可能会看到的一些可怕的事情。这个消息传出时，她已经完成了惊人的九次预选赛。
